name: Puchipuchi Idol Kouhosei ~Hayaku Shite yo! Manager Desho~
original_name: ぷちぷちアイドル候補生 ～早くシてよ！マネージャーでしょ～
source:
The gravure videos of various idols circulate throughout the world.
Two girls are rising in popularity as the next generation of such idols.
They both seemed to be the very definition of idols in the rough.

Recognizing their popularity, the agency plans to debut them as an idol duo, 
appointing an employee (the protagonist) with an outstanding track record in the company as their manager and sending them to a training camp....

However, the two girls are constantly opposing each other, 
even going so far as to ask the protagonist, whom they both like, for his support.
Our protagonist, an experienced and shrewd businessman, is in a hard-pressed fluster.

Singing, dancing, studying, eating and sleeping together, the girls work hard in their lessons, while the manager, tossed about by the girls, gets the training camp underway.

Will the girls be able to become the shining idols they deserve to be? Or...!?

[translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006709.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
各类偶像的写真视频在世间广为流传。
两名少女的人气正迅速攀升，被视为下一代写真偶像。
二人都堪称尚待雕琢的偶像璞玉。

事务所看中她们的人气，计划让二人组成偶像组合出道，并任命公司内业绩卓越的员工（主人公）为经纪人，带她们前往集训营……

然而，两个女孩总是针锋相对，甚至因为都喜欢主人公而争相要求他站在自己一边。
这让经验丰富、精明干练的主人公也狼狈不堪。

女孩们一起唱歌、跳舞、学习、吃饭、睡觉，在课程中努力训练；被她们折腾得团团转的经纪人，也就这样拉开了集训的序幕。

她们能否成长为本应成为的闪耀偶像？还是说……？
